title: Open Agents — build board
description: Work in flight on dennisonbertram/fork-open-agents. Cards are real GitHub PRs, real GitHub issues, or named local work. Nothing here is a projection or a target. A card in Shipped means the change is merged to main and the commit is deployed to production.
headerNote: Snapshot: 2026-08-17 17:05. Production is main@9423d9f7, HTTP 200. develop is ahead by two merged fixes awaiting release.

columnDescriptions.Backlog: Filed and not started. Open issues and unmerged older PRs.
columnDescriptions.In progress: Being worked now, no PR open yet.
columnDescriptions.In review: PR open. Waiting on CI, review, or a merge train slot.
columnDescriptions.Shipped: Merged to main and live on production.

cards.title: Readiness must check the allowlist the dispatcher enforces
cards.note: Merged to develop 2026-08-17. Not on main yet — rides release #1329. Found today: the fix existed on a branch since 2026-08-17 but was never opened as a PR, so production readiness still reports green for a repo the dispatcher refuses.

cards.note: Merged to develop 2026-08-17. Not on main yet — rides release #1329. Codex raised one P2 (a deleted loop returned 409 instead of 404); fixed in 517cca51 and the thread is resolved.
